h1: Bosch dishwasher tine clip replacement, set of 4
answer_first: We print a set of four replacement tine clips for Bosch style dishwasher racks to order, matched to your rack photos. Send a picture with a coin for scale and we quote within 24 hours, from $16.
fits: Bosch dishwasher rack tine clips (confirm by photo; the original kit number is 00428344)
problem: The clips that hold folding tines on a dishwasher rack get brittle with heat and detergent, and snap or wear out. Once one is lost, the tine will not stay upright and plates tip over.
oem_situation: An original clip kit, number 00428344, costs about $50. Our set of four starts at $16, and the final figure depends on the clip shape.
our_part: We print in ASA because dishwasher heat can warp ordinary hobby plastics. We make no food-contact claims; the clips sit on the rack and are not meant to touch food. Heat and water age any plastic, so treat the clips as a repair that may need renewing. We need photos of a surviving clip, the tine and the rack, with a coin for scale.

how_to_order: Remove one surviving clip or tine end if you can, and photograph it next to a coin.
Send photos on the request page, with a coin or ruler in the shot and the model number if you have it. We reply with a quote within 24 hours on business days.
Approve the quote and we print the part, usually in 5 to 10 business days after approval, then ship it to you.

faqs.q: Can a printed clip survive dishwasher heat?
faqs.a: ASA tolerates heat better than ordinary hobby plastics, but we cannot promise the lifespan of the original. We make no certification claims.

faqs.q: Is a printed part as strong as the original?
faqs.a: We do not claim it matches the original. Printed layers are weakest where they pull apart, so we orient the print so the main load runs along them, and we tell you if a part is a poor candidate. Tine clips carry a light load, so the main risk is heat aging, not strength.

faqs.q: How do I measure or photograph the part?
faqs.a: Photograph the clip from the side and the end, and the tine where it fits, on a plain background with a coin or ruler beside it. Send the dishwasher model number if you can find it. If you still have a broken piece, photograph that too.
We make no food-contact claims. The clips are on the rack, away from where food sits, but we do not certify them.
We match the clip from photos rather than a model list. Send the rack and the clip and we confirm the fit.
